title: Stability classification and further independence theory
details: Develop saturated models of prescribed cardinality under explicit cardinal-arithmetic hypotheses. Extend fixed-formula definability from whole models to arbitrary parameter sets and develop appropriate finite-family or coded uniformity statements. Prove the full equivalence between absence of the order property and cardinal bounds on complete types, and develop the stability spectrum. Further continuations include forking, ranks and classification beyond strongly minimal theories; use the model classification by dimension as the geometric base case. Field-specific applications need their algebraic prerequisites and remain separate from the basic equality/order examples.
